name: maxio-sdk
description: Install and consume the Maxio Advanced Billing .NET SDK with a bundled, generated SDK map plus subagent orchestration — an integrate-maxio router, a map-grounded maxio-plan contract-sheet agent, and a map-first maxio-debug agent. Answers signatures, models, enums, and errors by map lookup and clones the SDK source only on first need. No MCP server.
